messages:
Incidents Bot: Pager triggered | service=inference-api-us-west | severity=P1 | symptom=high tail latency on text-gen endpoints. War room: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (pin: 1357)

Maria Chen: I'm taking owner. joining war room now. @Sasha can you confirm you got paged?

Sasha Gomez: ack — oncall here. seeing p95 spike ~3.4s starting 14:12 UTC. checking queue and mem.

Raj Patel: SRE joining. grabbing runtime traces and redis stats.

Evan Brooks: eng-runtime here. initial glance => KV cache eviction bursts and one model replica reporting OOM-restart counts.

Sasha Gomez: quick commands:
```
# queue depth
redis-cli -h redis-prod.us-west --raw LLEN inference:queue:us-west
# check GPU mem
ssh gpunode-5 "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits"
```
results: queue~940, gpunode-5 mem=12050MB

Maria Chen: preliminary impact: ~15-25% of requests in us-west hit >3s tails. No increased 5xx, just retries/backpressure. drafting internal notice — dont publish yet.

Infra Bot: Autoscaler: scale request queued -> add 3 replicas to inference-dynamic-usw (req-id: as-2044)

Sasha Gomez: applying mitigations: pausing nightly ingestion batches (non-urgent), adding fallback routing for low-priority API keys to compact-1.

Evan Brooks: flipping routing: adding rule now, will route 30% of low-priority traffic to model-compact-1.

Incidents Bot: Action logged: fallback routing updated (id: fb-7781)

Raj Patel: I'm tweaking redis eviction TTL for active prefixes to reduce churn. pushing small config bump.

Sasha Gomez: scale completed. queue reduced -> ~320. p95 sampled down 3.4s -> 1.8s. observing cheaper tails but still seeing KV eviction spikes every ~6m.

Maria Chen: good progress. SupportLead — prepare a targeted customer notification list (customers with >100tpm in us-west). Keep hold until we confirm 30m stability.

Support Lead: list prepared. will wait for go. also prepping CS template for targeted message.

Maria Chen: Draft status update (internal):
```
Status: Investigating
Component: Redwood Hosted API (us-west)
Summary: Elevated latency for text generation in us-west; mitigation in progress (scaling + routing fallbacks). Some customers may see slower responses. No errors returned; requests complete with longer latency.
Next update: in 20m or on mitigation milestone.
```

Evan Brooks: follow-ups logged: 1) increase cache TTL for active prefixes, 2) add alert on KV eviction rate and OOM restart count, 3) capacity review for gpunode-5.

Raj Patel: adding runbook action: if eviction rate > X then auto-scale cache nodes. filing ticket INC-2024-847.

Maria Chen: if stable for 30m we'll transition to P2 and publish a customer note. For now: owner=M. Chen, SRE=R. Patel, EngRuntime=E. Brooks, Oncall=S. Gomez.

Sasha Gomez: marking the incident as in mitigation. will keep monitoring and post metrics snapshots in 10m. :eyes:

Maria Chen: thanks team. I'll write the internal postmortem template and assign follow-ups. :thumbsup:
